text: The BBK Foundation (Berik and Bayan Kaniyev Foundation), a Barys partner since September 2026, describes itself as a private foundation whose projects Kaniyev family members are personally involved in.
short: BBK Foundation is the Kaniyev family's private charitable foundation.

source.name: Berik and Bayan Kaniyev Foundation — bbkfoundation.kz
source.quote: This is a private foundation that supports education, culture, sports, and social initiatives in Kazakhstan.
source.note: The same page says: 'The Kaniyev family members are personally involved in the foundation's projects' and names Berik Kaniyev as its founder.
